original_topic: empirical workplace email and chat studies on structured action and decision extraction, focusing on owner assignment, deadline-to-action binding, conditional or negated obligations, and evidence-span annotation
topic: empirical workplace email and chat studies on structured action and decision extraction, focusing on owner assignment, deadline-to-action binding, conditional or negated obligations, and evidence-span annotation
focus: academic gaps of the previous round

prior_gaps.description: There is no direct modern workplace email/chat benchmark in this corpus that jointly annotates speech-act type, owner/assignee, action object, deadline, conditions/exceptions, and exact evidence spans.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: "action item extraction" workplace email chat owner assignee deadline condition span corpus

prior_gaps.description: Direct empirical evidence for extracting decisions, approvals, rejections, and proposals with structured arguments from authentic workplace email or chat is still missing from this corpus.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: "decision extraction" workplace email approval rejection proposal structured argument dialogue act

prior_gaps.description: Owner/assignee extraction remains weakly evidenced, especially for implicit owners, group ownership, multiple actions with different owners, and owners recoverable only from organizational or conversation context.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: ("assignee extraction" OR "owner extraction" OR "responsibility extraction") email action item implicit argument workplace

prior_gaps.description: The corpus does not establish reliable deadline binding in workplace communication: distinguishing a deadline for a particular action from a merely mentioned date, shared date, scheduling expression, or conditional future time remains open.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: "deadline extraction" email action item temporal relation due date event argument workplace

prior_gaps.description: Direct workplace evidence is insufficient for attaching conditions, exceptions, negation, and modality to the correct action when several actions or clauses occur together.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: ("conditional commitment" OR "deontic modality") workplace email negation scope condition action extraction

prior_gaps.description: Build an independent argument-level benchmark and adversarial fixture suite covering implicit owners, multiple actions in one sentence, shared deadlines, conditional and negated actions, overlapping request/commitment labels, quoted-history contamination, and attachment references; score false positives, false negatives, and each argument separately.
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Create a manually curated benchmark with an explicit annotation schema for speech act, action, owner, object, deadline, condition, polarity, provenance, and evidence spans. Include adversarial minimal pairs and multi-action examples, define train/development/test separation, and report precision, recall, F1, exact-match, argument-level accuracy, and per-error-category false-positive and false-negative counts.

prior_gaps.description: Compare sentence-local, message-level, and selectively expanded thread-context extraction with controlled ablations, because the literature shows both context gains and context-induced degradation.
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Implement three controlled extraction configurations using the same model, prompt or classifier, decoding settings, and benchmark: sentence-only input, full-message input, and selective thread expansion. Run ablations that vary prior-message depth and context-selection rules, then compare act-level and argument-level precision, recall, F1, calibration, latency, and context-induced error categories.

prior_gaps.description: Test author/quoted/forwarded content zoning while preserving provenance, and measure whether zoning improves act and argument extraction without losing obligations whose interpretation depends on prior-message context.
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Implement deterministic or learned zoning for newly authored text, quoted history, forwarded content, signatures, and attachment references while retaining source-message and span provenance. Benchmark extraction with zoning disabled, hard exclusion of quoted material, and provenance-preserving selective inclusion; measure both false-obligation reduction and recall loss for context-dependent obligations.

prior_gaps.description: Evaluate an uncertainty-preserving structured output in which owner, deadline, condition, or act subtype can remain unresolved, and measure whether this reduces false obligations and wrong argument assignments without unacceptable recall loss.
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Define nullable or explicitly unresolved fields plus confidence or abstention rules for owner, deadline, condition, and act subtype. Evaluate against a fixed benchmark across confidence thresholds, reporting selective precision/recall, coverage, calibration, false-obligation rate, wrong-argument-assignment rate, and the recall cost of abstention.
